chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: Fletcher asks Horace's opinion; writing two versions for the band to vote on
summary: Fletcher played alternatives and asked Horace which he preferred; they sometimes wrote two versions, tested them on the band and used both when opinion was split.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
